root_motivation: **Who:** the Sonnet inner coders wm-build runs on RedBaron and ryzen7 for every mcphost PRD, and the hand coders on hotfixes.
user_persona: An agent that runs host.note.put {text, attach_to: {tool}} once and reads the note on that tool's description in every later session; the same user's second client sees it too.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the repo at the build's tip, When `scripts/gen-codemap.sh` runs, Then `CODEMAP.md` lists every path in `git ls-files 'src/**/*.rs'` exactly once, each with a size class and a non-empty `//!` summary, contains no `:<digits>` line reference, and is under 40,000 bytes (`tests/cmap_ac01.rs`)

Given `src/db.rs` with its `// ---- <name> ----` banners, When the map is generated, Then the db.rs entry lists every banner name in file order, and a fixture file of 5,000+ lines with no banner appears under "large files without sections" (`tests/cmap_ac02.rs`)
Given a fixture tree with a top-level `pub const FOO: &[&str]` registry, When the map is generated, Then the Registries section lists `FOO` with its file (`tests/cmap_ac03.rs`)

Given a fixture source file with no `//!` line in its first 5 lines, When the generator runs, Then it exits non-zero, names that file, and leaves `CODEMAP.md` unchanged; and the real tree passes (`tests/cmap_ac04.rs`)

Given a fixture copy with one source file added after generation, When `scripts/gen-codemap.sh --check` runs, Then it exits 1 naming the added path; on a freshly generated copy it exits 0; and ci.yml's `regen-check` job invokes `scripts/gen-codemap.sh --check` (`tests/cmap_ac05.rs`)

Given the build merged to origin/main, When a fresh shallow clone of origin/main's tip runs `scripts/gen-codemap.sh --check` against its committed `CODEMAP.md`, Then it exits 0 and the clone carries `CLAUDE.md` naming `CODEMAP.md` (Live; evidence: `cmd:d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/j0yen/mcphost "$d" && cd "$d" && test -f CODEMAP.md && grep -q CODEMAP.md CLAUDE.md && ./scripts/gen-codemap.sh --check && echo codemap-live-ok` prints `codemap-live-ok`; today the clo...
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (fresh clone of origin/main tip runs scripts/gen-codemap.sh --check green and CLAUDE.md names CODEMAP.md; evidence path scripts/gen-codemap.sh)

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the repo root, When `CLAUDE.md` is read, Then it is under 30 lines and contains the strings `CODEMAP.md` and `scripts/gen-codemap.sh`, and that script path exists and is executable (`tests/cmap_ac07.rs`)

Given a fixture copy where only one function body in a 2,000+ line file changes (same line-count class, no banner, `//!` or registry change), When the map is regenerated, Then `CODEMAP.md` is byte-identical (`tests/cmap_ac08.rs`)

scope: src/notes.rs: host.note.put/list/delete over the notes/ prefix of tenant_state_kv; the tools/list description suffix.
src/handler.rs, src/protocol/frames.rs: tools, dispatch, list_changed on a tool-attached put/delete (keyed row allows list_changed).
src/plans.rs, src/retention.rs, src/db.rs: notes_max plan field; expired-note sweep.
contracts/, docs/, www/: regenerated tool contract, output schemas, docs.
non_goals: Notes attached to runs surfaced in host.runs.get (R6), attached_to in host.resume/welcome_back (R5), pin (R7); shared notebooks across tenants.

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the next session repeat a mistake the last one learned from?
five_whys_trace.a: The only write path is remember at signup; nothing pins a note to the tool it is about.
